rachel (Comms): Quick postmortem follow-up: we need a single publish flow for customer summaries + RCAs, a named owner for redaction, and a recurring-incident flag in the postmortem. Who can own redaction?

diego (SRE): I'll take the redaction checklist. Plan to include: strip PII/keys, mask customer hostnames, avoid verbatim request/response dumps.

anya (Customer Success): Timeline: CS needs a 72h summary template and a 3-line "for your customers" blurb we can reuse. Also ask for a "severity" field so we know outreach priority.

trent (Legal): 72h summary is fine. Any RCA with identifying info must be reviewed by Legal before external release. I'll draft a short consent/sign-off flow.

inc-bot: Reminder: create INCIDENT-9999 in tracker with 72h due for initial summary.

rachel (Comms): Draft statuspage short and 72h outline below, quick edits welcome.

STATUSPAGE (one-liner): "We experienced elevated errors affecting <service>. Mitigation applied; service stable as of <end>. Follow-up summary within 72 hours."

72H CUSTOMER SUMMARY (outline): impact, mitigation, CS-ready 3-line blurb, next steps + owner + ETA, support link.

diego (SRE): I'll also add a `recurring-pattern-check` to the postmortem template: query past 180 days for similar error signatures and set `recurring=true/false`. If true, include recommended outreach level in the 72h summary.

anya (Customer Success): Perfect. If `recurring=true` please include recommended outreach (none / targeted emails / account outreach) and suggested copy.

trent (Legal): For consent: if we include a customer quote or example that identifies them, obtain written consent with exact text. Sign-off chain: SRE -> Legal -> Comms. I'll add examples of disallowed content to the checklist.

rachel (Comms): Action items: diego: redaction checklist + recurring query (48h), rachel: status + 72h template + CS blurb (24h), trent: consent/sign-off doc (72h), anya: CS reuse snippets (3 business days). React with :+1: to accept.

diego (SRE): :+1:

anya (Customer Success): :+1:

trent (Legal): :+1:

rachel (Comms): I'll create the tracker items and schedule a 20m sync to walk through edge cases (regulated customers, on-prem). Leaving thread open for any objections.
